title: Poll NSX Policy realization before listing project security policies
prompt: Implement the single-file Java client in src/NsxPolicyClient.java. Follow README.md and the pinned contract in docs/contract.json. The client must create or replace a project security policy, poll its realized-state status to a successful terminal state, then return the project security-policy collection sorted locally. Do not modify the public API or protected task files.
scenario: a project security-policy upsert must be polled to realized SUCCESS before the collection is listed, and the returned collection must be sorted locally
constraint: the contract-pinned loopback request log proves the client polled realization to a terminal success before every list and never trusted server collection order
